name: haunters.net
detailed_description:
A Single-Player Investigative Horror Experience

You're tech-savvy and in need of quick cash. You discover a shady website where home and business owners post ghost hunting bounties, and you remotely command real ghost hunters in the field to identify ghosts and get paid.

Your goal is simple. Identify spirits, earn money, upgrade your gear, climb the ranks of the paranormal underworld, and escape each bounty with your ghost hunters alive.

It won't be easy. Some ghosts don't like being hunted.

This game is currently in development. The game does not and will never require you to actually sign up to a website - the website in the game as shown in the screenshot is fictional and a part of the game, not a real site. More information will be posted soon. If this sounds interesting, please feel free to wishlist!

short_description: haunters.net is a singleplayer investigative horror experience. Accept bounties on haunters.net - a fictional "Ghost Hunters for Hire" contracting business - to hunt ghosts, gather evidence & spot anomalies, earn new items, unlock new maps / contract types, and more.
